title: Payment Arrangement Plans When the Customer Moves
content:
# Payment Arrangement Plans When the Customer Moves

**Rule.** When the customer stops electric service at one address and starts service at another, an active Payment Arrangement plan of a kind that moves with the customer moves to the new service agreement. The plan moves only to a service agreement of the same customer that is pending start or active, as the service agreement record shows. The installment schedule, the installment numbering and the missed-installment count continue unchanged, and the next installment is billed on the first regular bill of the new agreement. Plans of a kind that does not move, and plans of a different customer, never move; they end with the closing agreement.

## Moving a plan — conditions and results

| Condition | Result |
|---|---|
| Kind moves with the customer; new agreement of the same customer, pending start | Plan moves |
| Kind moves with the customer; new agreement of the same customer, active | Plan moves |
| New agreement belongs to a different customer | Plan does not move |
| Kind does not move with the customer | Plan does not move |

## What carries over (hypothetical plan)

An active Winter Protection Plan has billed installments 1 to 3 of 8 and carries one missed installment. After the move, installment 4 is billed on the first regular bill of the new agreement, the remaining installments keep their numbers, and the plan still carries one missed installment.
